description: Use this tool when an agent needs to parse clean webpage article content without wasting context tokens on ads, scripts, navigation, and HTML boilerplate, or when summarizing a specific URL. Converts any URL into clean Markdown optimized for LLM context windows. Do not use for raw API endpoints or binary files (PDF/images). Paid in USDC on Base.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the webpage to convert to Markdown.

name: tools.ai_markdown
